column3: Men with HIV serve as friends and role models for other men with HIV, helping them to see how HIV and masculinity can be compatible. Men also benefit from support from other friends, family and community members. Frustration that health facilities have long waiting times, unavailable providers, and unavailable testing kits and/or ART.
